title: Kyutai CADRE: Video Autoencoders That Cut World Model Lag Below 230 ms
summary: Kyutai released CADRE, a family of 7 open causal diffusion video autoencoders for interactive world models. World models built on CADRE run at 20 fps on 1 H100 and react in under 230 ms. The post Kyutai CADRE: Video Autoencoders That Cut World Model Lag Below 230 ms appeared first on MarkTechPost .

title: Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K3.1 Pro: A 2.8T Total/104B Active Params (MoE) Model with 1M Context
summary: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3.1 Pro, a 2.8T-parameter, 104B-active MoE model with 1M-token context. It scores 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, costs $2/$10 per million tokens, and open weights arrive by Nov 4, 2026. The post Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K3.1 Pro: A 2.8T Total/104B Active Params (MoE) Model with 1M Context appeared first on MarkTechPost .

title: TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents
summary: TinyFish published two engineering research articles on agentic search. One defines a 7-phase production architecture with evidence contracts and bounded retries. The other explains why its deep research system dropped a separate planner and per-query subagents. The post TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .
